integrity: All face and character calculations are exact and reconstructed by two nonidentical implementations. The published nonequivariant sphere-wedge theorem is acknowledged as prior work; only its S6-module refinement is claimed.
limitations: A single fifteen-vertex ordinary open-neighborhood complex; rational second-homology S6-character only, not full equivariant homotopy or integral lattice decomposition. Bibliographic novelty is subject to unindexed literature.
title: Rational symmetry decomposition of the Kneser neighborhood complex on six points
